subject: EdgeConf follow-up: inference priorities + proposed next steps
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Aaron Li <aaron.li@edgescale.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 16:15:00 -0400
Subject: Quick notes from EdgeConf — inference latency priorities and next steps

Hi Aaron — great to meet you in person at EdgeConf yesterday. Thanks for walking me through EdgeScale's inference roadmap; I wanted to capture the highlights and proposed next steps so we can align with your infra and product teams.

TL;DR:
- Primary pain: 95th pct latency spikes during peak batch scoring (vision + text pipelines) causing timeouts in downstream services.
- Top priorities: predictable p95 under 200ms, per-route cost visibility, and a safe path to on-prem/private deployment for regulated customers.
- Redwood value: high-throughput serving runtime (KV caching + prefix reuse), smart routing for mixed-cost models, and a private deployment option with KMS integration.

Suggested next steps:
1) 60-min technical deep dive with your infra + ML infra owners next week — goal: share perf baselines and validate QoS targets.
2) A short mutual action plan (MAP) for a 6-week pilot (proof-of-cost, latency SLOs) — I attached a one-pager.
3) If infra sign-off looks good, schedule a live demo of a comparable workload (we can replay a small subset of your offline traces).

Attachments: edgeconf-map.pdf (MAP one-pager), redwood-demo-link.txt (demo scheduling link)

If you prefer, I can coordinate a couple of windows for the deep dive (Tue/Wed morning PST). What works for your infra team?

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
